<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snc_campusmatch_campusmatch_claim</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_snc_campusmatch_campusmatch_claim">claim_statusCHANGESTOApproved^EQ<item display_value="Approved" endquery="false" field="claim_status" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESTO" or="false" value="Approved"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>CampusMatch - Generate Collection Token</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /* null when async */) {

    /* ==========================================
       ONLY WHEN CLAIM BECOMES APPROVED
    ========================================== */

    var status =
        (
            current.getValue(
                'u_claim_status'
            ) || ''
        )
        .toLowerCase();


    if (status !== 'approved') {
        return;
    }


    /* ==========================================
       GENERATE ONLY ONCE
    ========================================== */

    if (
        !current.getValue(
            'collection_token'
        )
    ) {

        current.setValue(
            'collection_token',
            gs.generateGUID()
        );

    }


    current.setValue(
        'handover_completed',
        false
    );

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-21 09:18:15</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>c2a81c14716303107f4447ef815abe23</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CampusMatch - Generate Collection Token</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="CampusMatch" source="x_snc_campusmatch">50fd9dde64d703107f44b7462480e65b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CampusMatch">50fd9dde64d703107f44b7462480e65b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_c2a81c14716303107f4447ef815abe23</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-21 09:18:15</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=c2a81c14716303107f4447ef815abe23"/></record_update>
